summary: Employee Portal + Production Tracking Integration testing completed (iteration 59). All 23 backend API tests passed covering: employee authentication (email+PIN), GET /api/employee-portal/jobs (assigned jobs), GET /api/employee-portal/work-summary (work stats), GET /api/employee-portal/jobs/{job_id} (job detail with timelines), POST /api/employee-portal/jobs/{job_id}/timeline/{timeline_id}/stage/{stage_order} (start/pause/complete actions), admin job assignment via PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/assign-employees, tenant scoping for employee data. Frontend testing passed: Employee Portal login works, Dashboard shows Personal Work Summary + My Assigned Jobs sections, Job Detail page shows production timeline stages with action buttons, Admin Job Details page shows Assigned Employees card with Manage dialog, Production Timeline stage editor allows employee assignment to specific stages.

minor.issue: FIXED: Message typo 'Stage pauseed' → 'Stage paused' - corrected action message formatting

Employee Portal Login (email + PIN).description: Login with email portal-stage@test.com and PIN 2468 works correctly, returns access_token, employee_id, employee_name, tenant_id

GET /api/employee-portal/jobs.description: Returns list of jobs assigned to the logged-in employee with job_number, job_name, customer_name, job_type, current_production_stage, priority, due_date

GET /api/employee-portal/jobs/{job_id}.description: Returns job detail with job, customer_name, job_items, timelines arrays - timelines include stages for production tracking

POST /api/employee-portal/jobs/{job_id}/.description: Supports start, pause, complete actions on timeline stages - updates stage status and timestamps

Tenant scoping for employee data.description: Employee cannot access job details for jobs not assigned to them (returns 404), tenant_id is validated

Admin: PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/assign-emp.description: Admin can assign employees to a job via employee_ids array, assignment persists and appears in job details

Admin: Job Details includes assigned_emp.description: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/details returns assigned_employee_details array with id, name, role for each assigned employee

No regression: Pay/Profile endpoints.description: GET /api/employee-portal/profile, GET /api/employee-portal/pay/summary working with correct data structure

Frontend: Employee Portal Dashboard.description: Dashboard shows Personal Work Summary card (Today's Completed Stages, Assigned Jobs, Hours Today, Hours This Week) and My Assigned Jobs section

Frontend: Employee Portal Job Detail.description: Job detail page shows job name, customer, due date, Production Timeline with stages and Start/Pause/Complete buttons

Frontend: Admin Job Assignment UI.description: Job Details page shows Assigned Employees card with Manage button, dialog shows checkboxes for employees, Save Assignments button works

Frontend: Timeline Stage Editor with Emp.description: Production Timeline panel shows stages with edit buttons, stage editor dialog includes Assigned Employee dropdown, Start/End time overrides, Notes field
